headline: Brazil Approves Wegovy as First Oral GLP-1 Obesity Pill
summary: Brazil's regulator Anvisa approved the Wegovy pill, marking the first oral GLP-1 drug for obesity approved in the country and opening a major market for Novo Nordisk.
why: Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company specializing in diabetes and obesity treatments. The approval of oral GLP-1 therapies in major Latin American economies significantly expands the addressable market for obesity treatments.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: Regulatory approval of Wegovy in Brazil opens a new commercial revenue stream in Latin America's largest pharmaceutical market.
